title: SafeAFK
description: Monitor your Minecraft health remotely with a companion mobile app.
body:
SAFK (Safe AFK) is a client-side Fabric mod that lets you monitor your Minecraft player’s health in real time from a companion mobile app.

Perfect for AFKing safely — get notified instantly when your health drops or you're in danger.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📱 Companion App Required
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This mod works together with the SafeAFK iOS app.

The app allows you to:
• View your health in real time
• Receive alerts when health changes
• Get a death warning when low health is detected

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚙️ Features
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Real-time health syncing
• Alerts at key health levels
• Death warning system
• Simple linking system
• Lightweight and optimized

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔗 Setup Instructions
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
1. Install Fabric Loader
2. Install Fabric API
3. Place SAFK mod in your mods folder
4. Launch Minecraft
5. Use the /link safk <code> command
6. Enter the code from the mobile app

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
📦 Requirements
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Fabric Loader
• Fabric API
• SAFK mobile app

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚠️ Notes
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• This is a client-side mod
• Internet connection is required
• Your data is not stored permanently

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
